name: auto-skill-update-plugin
description: Triggers proactively when the user signals any skill should be improved -- e.g., 'update the skill to cover X', 'add this case to skill', 'the skill missed this case'. Also triggers on Chinese equivalents: '更新这个skill', 'skill漏了这个情况', '给skill加上这个情况'. Applies minimal, surgical edits to skill definitions -- covering new trigger patterns, handling cases, or examples -- without rewriting wholesale.
